title: Terms of Reference (TOR) for the Procurement of Goods: Procurement of Equipment and Materials for PNAD and the Strengthening of Digital Technologies in the Education System of São Tomé and Príncipe
why_not: A UNICEF tender for 80 tablets and 90 computers for the digital learning programme (PNAD) and school ICT rooms; pedagogical equipment, nothing on learner records or SIGE.
